(async()=>{const G=(await import('/js/flight/gtiles.js')).GT, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'), W=(await import('/js/flight/world.js')).W; const T=G.tiles; const acc={update:0, compose:0, mirror:0, parse:0, model:0}; const wrap=(obj,name,key)=>{ const f=obj[name].bind(obj); obj[name]=(...a)=>{ const t=performance.now(); const r=f(...a); if(r&&r.then){ return r.finally(()=>{acc[key]+=performance.now()-t}); } acc[key]+=performance.now()-t; return r; }; }; wrap(T,'update','update'); wrap(E.composer,'render','compose'); const ob=W.water.onBeforeRender; W.water.onBeforeRender=function(...a){ const t=performance.now(); ob.apply(this,a); acc.mirror+=performance.now()-t; }; const tasks=[]; try{ new PerformanceObserver(l=>{ for(const e of l.getEntries()) tasks.push(Math.round(e.duration)); }).observe({type:'longtask', buffered:false}); }catch(e){} const frames=[]; let last=performance.now(); const t0=last; let prev={...acc}; await new Promise(res=>{ const f=()=>{ const now=performance.now(); const dt=now-last; last=now; const d={}; for(const k in acc){ d[k]=Math.round(acc[k]-prev[k]); } prev={...acc}; if(dt>100) frames.push({t:+((now-t0)/1000).toFixed(1), dt:Math.round(dt), ...d}); if(now-t0<8000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); return JSON.stringify({frames:frames.slice(0,10), longtasks:tasks.sort((a,b)=>b-a).slice(0,12), totals:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(acc).map(([k,v])=>[k,Math.round(v)]))})})()
